correctness.rationale: The exact identity Sigma=-Hess I(0)/(2I(0))=Cov(f/S) is derived from a double integral. Each ball has covariance r^2/(d+2) times identity; the mixture's between-center contribution is positive rank one. In \(d\ge2\) the smallest eigenvalue extracts within-ball variance; the strict monotonicity of the positive power-sum at fixed volume recovers unordered radii and the spectral gap and top eigenspace recover the relative center vector up to sign. All quantifiers, coincident and equal-radius boundaries, and sharp first-jet insufficiency are accounted for analytically.

value.rationale: Natural and complete two-ball inverse model with no radius, overlap or separation exclusions: exactly the 0th and 2nd order Fourier-intensity observables recover every configuration modulo necessary ambiguities. The result gives a reconstruction algorithm, identifies the sharp minimal derivative order, and sharply contrasts with 1D interval phase retrieval requiring higher-order information. The fact is more than a special numerical example or routine reparameterization.
